tasks.title: Implement WorkflowRun aggregate decisions
tasks.description: Create the WorkflowRun domain aggregate with StageRun, TaskRun, CheckState, stage definitions, decisions, and pure command methods. The aggregate must enforce stage admission, one active stage, task order, task-before-check, approval, fix scheduling, completion, failure reasons, Integrate freeze, and no-rollback invariants without writing database rows directly.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRun can start from the configured stage order and starts the first StageRun without WorkflowEngine hardcoding backlog-to-plan
completeTask rejects out-of-order task completion and enters checks only after all required tasks are terminal
recordCheckResult records pass/fail/error/pending results, schedules fix tasks by policy, records causedBy metadata, and fails unrepaired checks with a traceable reason
approveStage and rejectStage only work while the current StageRun is awaiting approval and preserve approval output
Integrate merge completion records delivery metadata and freezes the StageRun so health:integrate failure cannot schedule a fix task
Unit tests cover all ten listed workflow invariants and the failure reasons task-failed, check-unrepaired, approval-rejected, and post-merge-health-failed
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the domain API intention-level. Do not expose row-shaped setters such as setStagePassed or upsertCheck from the aggregate.

tasks.title: Persist WorkflowRun aggregate transactionally
tasks.description: Refactor WorkflowRun persistence so the repository loads and saves the aggregate as one consistency boundary over workflow_runs, workflow_stage_runs, workflow_tasks, and workflow_checks. Add read-repair for partially seeded active runs and keep row-level update helpers as repository internals rather than public business APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository load returns a WorkflowRun aggregate snapshot with ordered StageRuns, tasks, checks, approval snapshots, and delivery metadata from existing rows
Repository save writes changed run, stage, task, check, approval, failure, and freeze state inside one database transaction
Loading an active run repairs missing static Plan and Integrate task/check rows idempotently without duplicating rows
Loading Build with tasks.json available can materialize missing Build task definitions without treating tasks.json progress as runtime truth
Persistence tests prove duplicate active runs are not created and repeated materialization does not duplicate task rows
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer using existing output fields for P0 metadata unless tests prove a small schema addition is required.

tasks.title: Add aggregate application service and projections
tasks.description: Introduce WorkflowApplicationService as the only runtime facade for start, materialize tasks, complete task, record check, approve/reject stage, and resume decisions. Add a projection component that applies aggregate decisions to issue stage/status, approval state, stage_states, check suites, workflow logs, and SSE without making those projections business authorities.
acceptanceCriteria: Start workflow command creates or reuses one active aggregate run and projects the current stage to the issue row
CompleteTask and RecordCheckResult commands load the aggregate, invoke domain methods, save transactionally, then update projections from the returned decision
Approval commands update aggregate approval state before projecting issue approval state and stage-state approval
Projection code treats stage_executions, stage_states, check suites, logs, and checkpoints as consumers or evidence rather than inputs to state decisions
Service tests prove projection writes occur after aggregate save and failed aggregate validation does not update projections
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Existing WorkflowRunService may temporarily delegate to this service, but new call sites should depend on the aggregate facade.

tasks.title: Convert runners to report task and check facts
tasks.description: Refactor BaseStageRunner and concrete stage runners so they execute requested task/check work and report facts to WorkflowApplicationService instead of deciding stage pass/fail, awaiting approval, next stage, or direct WorkflowRun lifecycle writes. Keep checks read-only and convert any code-changing repair or convergence behavior into explicit task reports with causedBy metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: BaseStageRunner no longer calls setStageStarted, setStagePassed, setStageFailed, setStageAwaitingApproval, upsertTask, or upsertCheck directly
Task execution reports StageTaskResult facts through the application service, including completed, failed, skipped, attempts, artifacts, output, reason, and causedBy metadata
Check execution reports CheckResult facts through the application service and does not directly schedule fixes, set approval, or complete stages
Repair work for health, review findings, merge readiness, and approval convergence is represented as task work rather than check side effects
Runner tests prove check failure classification and fix scheduling decisions come from the aggregate decision path, not BaseStageRunner private logic
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep stage_executions writes only as audit evidence if needed; they must not decide current state.

tasks.title: Drive WorkflowEngine from aggregate next work
tasks.description: Refactor WorkflowEngine to loop on WorkflowRun aggregate decisions and requested work instead of issue.stage plus StageRunResult.nextStage. Issue stage and issue status updates must be projection results, and workflow completion must come from the aggregate reaching its terminal state.
acceptanceCriteria: StageRunResult.nextStage is removed from the runtime progression path and no WorkflowEngine branch updates issue stage from runner nextStage
WorkflowEngine obtains the active WorkflowRun through WorkflowApplicationService and executes the aggregate's next runnable task, check, approval wait, or completion decision
Backlog-to-first-stage and stage-to-stage advancement are derived from aggregate stageOrder rather than hardcoded engine transitions
Workflow completion marks the run passed and projects issue completion only after the aggregate has no next stage
Engine tests prove Plan success advances by aggregate stageOrder and a failed stage stays local with visible failure reason
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes the runner reporting contract from T-004. Do not keep a fallback path where successful runner output independently chooses the next stage.

tasks.title: Make Build runtime tasks aggregate-backed
tasks.description: Move Build task materialization and progress tracking to WorkflowRun task state. Ralph may still read tasks.json as the design input, but task progress, skipped/completed/failed results, and failure evidence must be recorded through the aggregate and no longer depend on all-tasks-complete as a business check.
acceptanceCriteria: Build start materializes tasks.json entries into the Build StageRun through WorkflowApplicationService before execution begins
Ralph reports each task completed, failed, or skipped to the aggregate immediately after the external action result is known
Runtime progress and failure evidence returned by API/UI comes from workflow_tasks rather than tasks.json passes/error fields
all-tasks-complete is not executed as a Build business check in the aggregate-backed workflow path
Build tests cover repeated materialization, skipped task validation, task failure stopping the stage, and checkpoint resume without tasks.json as source of truth
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not delete tasks.json or stop using it as Plan artifact and Build input.

tasks.title: Domain-control Integrate delivery and freeze
tasks.description: Refactor Integrate so spec sync, archive, merge, and health:integrate are reported as aggregate task/check facts with delivery metadata. The aggregate must freeze the StageRun after merge and convert any post-merge health failure into a non-repairable workflow failure requiring manual intervention.
acceptanceCriteria: integrate:spec-sync, integrate:archive-change, and integrate:merge execute in aggregate task order and later tasks/checks do not run after an earlier task fails
integrate:merge completion records targetBranch, baseSha, candidateHeadSha, landedSha, and rebased in WorkflowRun task output or metadata
After integrate:merge completes, the StageRun records a freeze point and no automatic task that modifies code can be scheduled
health:integrate failure after freeze fails the stage/workflow with reason post-merge-health-failed and never schedules fix-integrate-health even if config enables auto-fix
API-visible Integrate task/check state shows archive/spec-sync/merge outcomes and landed sha without reading runner-local step arrays
Integrate tests cover spec-sync failure, archive failure, merge failure, merge success with freeze, health pass, and post-merge health failure
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Merge is an irreversible delivery side effect. Do not model rollback and do not hide landedSha in logs only. This task also satisfies specs/workflow-run/spec.md#REQ-WR-005 for Integrate runtime state.

tasks.title: Expose WorkflowRun-backed API and UI progress
tasks.description: Update API and Web UI read paths so active WorkflowRun state is the primary source for current stage, task, check, approval, failure, and Integrate delivery progress. Legacy stage_state, stage_execution, check_suite, log, and checkpoint data may remain fallback evidence only when no WorkflowRun exists.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:number/workflow-run returns the active aggregate-backed run with ordered StageRuns, tasks, checks, approval snapshots, failure details, and delivery metadata
GET /api/issues/:number/stage-state projects from WorkflowRun when available and does not promote stage_executions, logs, sessions, or checkpoints into primary tasks/checks
Issue Detail renders WorkflowRun-backed task and check progress and keeps tasks, checks, approval, and diagnostic evidence visually separate
PipelineView and TaskProgressPanel render the same WorkflowRun-backed task list and runtime-added fix tasks without exposing planned/dynamic/static task categories
Integrate UI shows spec-sync, archive, merge, landed sha, and health:integrate check state from persisted WorkflowRun data
API and frontend tests cover WorkflowRun-backed stage-state, no-run fallback, runtime-added task rendering, and Integrate delivery evidence
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes Build and Integrate aggregate state so the UI can verify both main runtime paths.

tasks.title: Remove bypassing workflow state writes
tasks.description: Delete or demote public WorkflowRunService lifecycle CRUD shortcuts and update remaining API, runner, recovery, approval, and service call sites to use aggregate commands. Add guard tests so future code cannot reintroduce direct stage pass/fail/awaiting-approval writes as business decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: No production caller outside repository internals can call setStagePassed, setStageFailed, setStageAwaitingApproval, setStageStarted, setRunStatus, upsertTask, or upsertCheck to decide business state
WorkflowRunService either delegates to WorkflowApplicationService for compatibility reads/start or no longer exposes bypassing lifecycle setters
Approval API records approve/reject through the aggregate and projections instead of mutating issue, stage_state, and WorkflowRun independently
Recovery/resume paths load aggregate state and preserve current stage/task/check visibility for existing active workflows
A regression test or static assertion fails if BaseStageRunner, WorkflowEngine, API routes, or Ralph directly invoke bypass methods
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do this after API/UI migration so compatibility reads remain stable while write shortcuts are removed.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end aggregate workflow regressions
tasks.description: Add focused integration and regression coverage proving the complete P0 workflow uses WorkflowRun as the business truth. Cover success, task failure, repairable check failure, approval pause/resume, Build materialization, Integrate delivery, post-merge health failure, and legacy projection fallback behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: An end-to-end Plan-to-Done test proves stages advance by WorkflowRun stageOrder and issue stage/status are projections
A failed task test proves the stage fails with task-failed reason and no later task/check runs
A repairable check failure test proves fix task causedBy metadata is recorded and recheck decisions are aggregate-driven
An approval test proves awaiting approval, approve, reject, and resume states are consistent across WorkflowRun, issue projection, and stage-state projection
An Integrate post-merge health failure test proves merge delivery metadata remains visible and workflow fails with manual-intervention evidence
Legacy compatibility tests prove active runs with partial WorkflowRun data keep current stage/task/check visibility after read-repair
Relevant backend and frontend tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep fixtures small and deterministic. Prefer service-level integration tests over full browser tests unless UI behavior cannot be verified otherwise.
